desc: Swap `S` and `T` if `len(S) > len(T)` to keep the outer loop over the shorter string.
Implement Ukkonen’s bounded edit distance DP with band width `K`, using two 1‑D arrays of size `K+1` (plus a sentinel), capping values at `K+1`.
After filling the DP, check whether the final cell `dp[n][m]` (or the last entry of the final column) is `≤ K` → print `Yes` or `No`.
Test on the provided samples and additional edge cases (e.g., `K=0`, very long identical strings, strings differing by exactly `K` operations).
Verify that the band logic correctly handles the edges of the DP table.
